mapper.select: SELECT request_hash,resource_id,processing_status FROM api_idempotency_record WHERE scope_tenant_id=#{tenantId} AND operation_id=#{operation} AND idempotency_key=#{key} AND expires_at > CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(3)
mapper.update: UPDATE api_idempotency_record SET resource_id=#{orderId},processing_status='SUCCEEDED',response_status=200 WHERE scope_tenant_id=#{tenantId} AND operation_id=#{operation} AND idempotency_key=#{key} AND processing_status='PROCESSING'
